Job Description: **3D ArchViz Supervisor**
=========================


Remote \| Canada

**Why You’ll Love Zonda**
-------------------------


Zonda delivers trusted data, leading marketplaces, and innovative digital solutions that empower builders, developers, and housing professionals to make smarter decisions throughout the homebuilding lifecycle. We’re here to build the future of housing because we believe better homes mean better lives and stronger communities.


Join a global, remote\-first team that’s curious, creative, and collaborative—and be part of what’s next in homebuilding.


When you join Zonda’s Virtual Team, you become part of a forward\-thinking group shaping how future homeowners experience communities before they’re built. Through immersive visualization, innovative technology, and creative storytelling, our team delivers industry\-leading virtual experiences that help builders market homes in smarter, more engaging ways.

**The Role**
------------


Zonda is seeking a 3D ArchViz Supervisor to lead and elevate our growing production teams responsible for creating high\-quality virtual marketing assets for the homebuilding industry. This leadership role oversees a large, multi\-disciplinary team producing architectural renderings, interior virtual tours, interactive experiences, and other immersive real estate marketing content.


This role blends creative leadership, technical expertise, operational oversight, and team development. The ideal candidate is passionate about photorealistic visualization, thrives in fast\-paced production environments, and enjoys mentoring artists while driving continuous improvement across workflows, tools, quality standards, and scalability.


You’ll work closely with creative leadership, development teams, project managers, and production staff to ensure projects are delivered on time, at a consistently high standard, and aligned with evolving industry trends and client expectations.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Contribute to the production and oversight of a wide range of 3D visualization and virtual experience projects.
* Lead, coach, mentor, and support a team of approximately 40 3D artists across multiple disciplines, teams, and production streams.
* Foster a collaborative, positive, and high\-performing team culture focused on creativity, accountability, and continuous growth.
* Partner closely with the Creative Director to drive scalable quality improvements across deliverables and production standards.
* Collaborate with development teams to improve workflows, optimize production pipelines, and help ensure tools remain innovative and efficient.
* Organize and facilitate team meetings, production reviews, and collaborative working sessions.
* Work cross\-functionally with project managers, creative leadership, and production teams to align on deliverables, timelines, client expectations, and quality standards.
* Troubleshoot technical and production challenges throughout the visualization pipeline.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, quality, consistency, and overall production performance.
* Assist with the development and maintenance of asset libraries, templates, documentation, and quality standards.
* Explore and evaluate emerging AI tools and technologies that can enhance production workflows, quality, scalability, and team efficiency.
* Stay current on industry trends, rendering techniques, visualization technologies, and real\-time production innovations.
* Support ongoing team development and contribute to performance management processes.
**Who You Are**
---------------


You are a creative and technically skilled visualization leader who knows how to balance artistic quality with operational execution. You’re passionate about architectural visualization, real\-time environments, and immersive digital experiences—and you enjoy helping teams grow and perform at a high level.


You thrive in collaborative, fast\-moving environments where innovation, adaptability, and continuous improvement are valued. You’re proactive, solutions\-oriented, and naturally curious about new tools, technologies, and production techniques, especially within AI and real\-time rendering workflows.


Most importantly, you know how to bring people together, inspire creative teams, and drive projects forward with consistency, clarity, and high standards.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* 10\+ years of professional experience in 3D visualization, architectural visualization, or real\-time environments.
* 3\+ years of leadership experience managing or overseeing production teams.
* Strong portfolio showcasing high\-quality architectural visualization and/or virtual experience work.
* Deep understanding of modeling, materials, lighting, interior design, photorealism, and rendering workflows.
* Advanced knowledge of:
	+ 3ds Max
	+ V\-Ray and/or Corona
	+ Unreal Engine
	+ Photoshop
* Demonstrated interest in exploring and leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies to improve production workflows, efficiency, quality, and scalability.
* Strong communication, problem\-solving, organizational, and leadership skills.
* Self\-starter mentality with a forward\-thinking and continuously learning mindset.
* Experience with Adobe Substance, Revit, or AutoCAD is a plus.
* Knowledge of scripting, automation, or production pipeline tools is a plus.
* Experience supporting residential homebuilders, real estate marketing, or related industries is preferred.
* Experience working with global or multi\-location production teams is preferred.
**Why You’ll Love This Role**
-----------------------------


This is an opportunity to help shape the future of immersive homebuyer experiences while leading talented artists and contributing to innovative visualization technologies. You’ll have the ability to influence creative quality, operational strategy, workflow evolution, and emerging technology adoption across a growing production organization.


At Zonda, your work directly impacts how communities are marketed, experienced, and brought to life.

**Perks**

* We offer meaningful work and opportunities for career growth
* Competitive Salary
* 100% paid by Zonda health benefit package
* 100% Company paid Life Insurance coverage
* Paid vacation and general holidays
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Paid Volunteer Day
* Summer Fridays
* Live Meditation Sessions
* Employee Recognition Platform
* Virtual Wellness Program
* Visionary Leadership Team
**Diversity \& Inclusion**
--------------------------


Zonda is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity, inclusion \& belonging. Here at Zonda, we are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in Canada.

Job Description: **3D ArchViz Supervisor**
=========================


Remote \| Canada

**Why You’ll Love Zonda**
-------------------------


Zonda delivers trusted data, leading marketplaces, and innovative digital solutions that empower builders, developers, and housing professionals to make smarter decisions throughout the homebuilding lifecycle. We’re here to build the future of housing because we believe better homes mean better lives and stronger communities.


Join a global, remote\-first team that’s curious, creative, and collaborative—and be part of what’s next in homebuilding.


When you join Zonda’s Virtual Team, you become part of a forward\-thinking group shaping how future homeowners experience communities before they’re built. Through immersive visualization, innovative technology, and creative storytelling, our team delivers industry\-leading virtual experiences that help builders market homes in smarter, more engaging ways.

**The Role**
------------


Zonda is seeking a 3D ArchViz Supervisor to lead and elevate our growing production teams responsible for creating high\-quality virtual marketing assets for the homebuilding industry. This leadership role oversees a large, multi\-disciplinary team producing architectural renderings, interior virtual tours, interactive experiences, and other immersive real estate marketing content.


This role blends creative leadership, technical expertise, operational oversight, and team development. The ideal candidate is passionate about photorealistic visualization, thrives in fast\-paced production environments, and enjoys mentoring artists while driving continuous improvement across workflows, tools, quality standards, and scalability.


You’ll work closely with creative leadership, development teams, project managers, and production staff to ensure projects are delivered on time, at a consistently high standard, and aligned with evolving industry trends and client expectations.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Contribute to the production and oversight of a wide range of 3D visualization and virtual experience projects.
* Lead, coach, mentor, and support a team of approximately 40 3D artists across multiple disciplines, teams, and production streams.
* Foster a collaborative, positive, and high\-performing team culture focused on creativity, accountability, and continuous growth.
* Partner closely with the Creative Director to drive scalable quality improvements across deliverables and production standards.
* Collaborate with development teams to improve workflows, optimize production pipelines, and help ensure tools remain innovative and efficient.
* Organize and facilitate team meetings, production reviews, and collaborative working sessions.
* Work cross\-functionally with project managers, creative leadership, and production teams to align on deliverables, timelines, client expectations, and quality standards.
* Troubleshoot technical and production challenges throughout the visualization pipeline.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, quality, consistency, and overall production performance.
* Assist with the development and maintenance of asset libraries, templates, documentation, and quality standards.
* Explore and evaluate emerging AI tools and technologies that can enhance production workflows, quality, scalability, and team efficiency.
* Stay current on industry trends, rendering techniques, visualization technologies, and real\-time production innovations.
* Support ongoing team development and contribute to performance management processes.
**Who You Are**
---------------


You are a creative and technically skilled visualization leader who knows how to balance artistic quality with operational execution. You’re passionate about architectural visualization, real\-time environments, and immersive digital experiences—and you enjoy helping teams grow and perform at a high level.


You thrive in collaborative, fast\-moving environments where innovation, adaptability, and continuous improvement are valued. You’re proactive, solutions\-oriented, and naturally curious about new tools, technologies, and production techniques, especially within AI and real\-time rendering workflows.


Most importantly, you know how to bring people together, inspire creative teams, and drive projects forward with consistency, clarity, and high standards.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* 10\+ years of professional experience in 3D visualization, architectural visualization, or real\-time environments.
* 3\+ years of leadership experience managing or overseeing production teams.
* Strong portfolio showcasing high\-quality architectural visualization and/or virtual experience work.
* Deep understanding of modeling, materials, lighting, interior design, photorealism, and rendering workflows.
* Advanced knowledge of:
	+ 3ds Max
	+ V\-Ray and/or Corona
	+ Unreal Engine
	+ Photoshop
* Demonstrated interest in exploring and leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies to improve production workflows, efficiency, quality, and scalability.
* Strong communication, problem\-solving, organizational, and leadership skills.
* Self\-starter mentality with a forward\-thinking and continuously learning mindset.
* Experience with Adobe Substance, Revit, or AutoCAD is a plus.
* Knowledge of scripting, automation, or production pipeline tools is a plus.
* Experience supporting residential homebuilders, real estate marketing, or related industries is preferred.
* Experience working with global or multi\-location production teams is preferred.
**Why You’ll Love This Role**
-----------------------------


This is an opportunity to help shape the future of immersive homebuyer experiences while leading talented artists and contributing to innovative visualization technologies. You’ll have the ability to influence creative quality, operational strategy, workflow evolution, and emerging technology adoption across a growing production organization.


At Zonda, your work directly impacts how communities are marketed, experienced, and brought to life.

**Perks**

* We offer meaningful work and opportunities for career growth

* 100% paid by Zonda health benefit package
* 100% Company paid Life Insurance coverage
* Paid vacation and general holidays
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Paid Volunteer Day
* Summer Fridays
* Live Meditation Sessions
* Employee Recognition Platform
* Virtual Wellness Program
* Visionary Leadership Team
**Diversity \& Inclusion**
--------------------------


Zonda is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity, inclusion \& belonging. Here at Zonda, we are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in Canada.
